notes: Summary: Stalled -> closed-lost. Orion was a strong product fit technically (latency and batching needs matched Redwood Dedicated). Primary drivers away from Redwood: cost model vs owning large on-prem GPU fleet, absolute KMS/HSM ownership requirement, and a change in internal champion. Also need air-gap option long-term.' - Head of Infra left in Dec; new owners prefer in-house inference stack. Timeline and deal health: procurement slowed by extended legal/security review and a last-minute budget reallocation to capital expenditure. Competitive dynamics: not lost to another vendor per se; decision was to self-host with vLLM/TGI and heavy TensorRT optimization. Action items we took: pricing concessions, offered private deployment checklist, offered HSM integration guidance, set up two technical deep dives on quantization and batching. Outcome: team signed internal purchase order for hardware and open-source stack in Feb 2026. Follow-up: archive opportunity, send a concise post-mortem to AE+SE team, invite Orion to Redwood "Private Ops" webinar and offer a free architecture review should they reconsider or need hybrid routing in future.
